---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for MuxCls
labels: enhancement
---

## Feature description
A clear description of the feature.

## Use case
Why is this needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed solution
How should it work from the user's perspective (scan report, selection prompts, output)?

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you've thought about.

## Notes
MuxCls uses FFmpeg stream copy (`ffmpeg -c copy`) and does not re-encode. Features that
would require re-encoding are out of scope.
